plugins.name: Reorder/Rename Models
plugins.description: Reorder, rename display names, and hide models in the global model catalog across Claude Code, Claude, OpenAI, Codex, Gemini, and Grok clients, with a built-in web editor. Set management_key in the plugin config. Made to work alongside Safeguard Killer (https://github.com/esauvisky/CLIProxyAPI-Safeguard-Killer-Plugin).
plugins.author: esauvisky
